preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of direct connections m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The index of the server v must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if m < n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of connections m is less than n - 1, output -1 indicating it's impossible to connect the servers.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == m and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If connections are possible, output m lines each containing two server indices.

postconditions.expression: any(int(line.split()[0]) == v or int(line.split()[1]) == v for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: At least one connection must involve the server v to ensure its failure disconnects the system.
